_comment: Template. Copy to env.json and fill in real values. Run with: flutter run --dart-define-from-file=env.json
_paystack: PUBLIC key only (pk_test_...). The SECRET key (sk_test_...) goes in Supabase Edge Function secrets and must never appear in this file or in env.json.
_google: Web client ID from Google Cloud Console. In this build it only enables the Google button; the real client ID and secret live in the Supabase dashboard. GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID is currently unused.
